status: PROPOSED (nothing else depends on it until the owner approves; no existing file uses it)
axes: x east, z north, y up: the game's route axes

canonicalAnchor.source: GeoNames id 2335204 (Kano), read offline from the geonamescache 3.0.2 dataset (the GeoNames web service is not reachable from this session)

crossChecks.source: OpenStreetMap city node as listed by Mapcarta (11.994N 8.522E; secondary listing, node 501540880)

canonicalAnchor.tolerance: about 1 km: a city anchor is a place point, not a surveyed benchmark. All the historic landmarks lie within 1.5 km of it.

transformToUnity.name: K0
transformToUnity.kind: local tangent plane (equirectangular) at the anchor
transformToUnity.beyondAbout25km: do not extend K0: use UTM zone 32N (EPSG:32632; Kano at 8.5E is inside zone 32, 6E to 12E) or a per-corridor frame with explicit connectors

chunkLattice.note: Every authored coordinate is a multiple of 200 m at chunk corners so neighbouring routes share the game's chunk lattice (ChunkStreamer.chunkSize).

transformToUnity.scalePolicy: City slices are 1:1. A compressed corridor (Lagos-Ibadan is compressed) declares its compression in meta and never shares a frame with 1:1 content.

slice.note: About 4 km south-west of the anchor on the Kaduna approach direction. A design choice, not a survey: no street here is a real street.

qibla.note: WGS84 geodesic initial azimuth from the anchor to the Kaaba (21.4225N 39.8262E): 68.46 degrees. Mosques in the slice orient their qibla wall to this, whatever the road does.

worldMapPin.provenanceInRepository: introduced with the whole world map on 2026-10-10 (commit 4973744) and the backend seed (a0d9b3f); no source is recorded anywhere. docs/WORLD_MAP.md calls city lat/lon 'authoritative' and only tests Lagos and Ibadan against the backend.
worldMapPin.whatItMatches: a Kano point listed as 12.00218N 8.59196E, altitude 469 m (distancefromto.net), not the usual city reference; the sources describe it as a different location within the Kano area
worldMapPin.isItIsolated: no: every game city pin differs from GeoNames by 1.7 to 10.8 km (Kano 8.2, Abuja 10.8, Lagos 8.0), so it is a convention of the pins, not a Kano slip

worldMapDiscrepancy.note: Kept for the test that the discrepancy stays recorded. Not changed; the owner decides.

reservedAnchors.name: Dala Hill
reservedAnchors.verified: ONE source (12°0'33.498"N 8°30'25.106"E); about 1.5 km from the city anchor; height disputed (534 m above sea level in most sources, 453.67 m in one)
